title: workflows split reader: .github/actions feeds the in-use inventory ungoverned, and gate spellings it cannot see
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

Filing gate: (b) a follow-up a review names. Contract review of PR #31628 (card #31538, merged 1a20cbc846): nit N3 in record 6724981811 and nit N5 in record 6725802382. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

PR #31628 让 objectstack 的工作流改动按 diff 判 Tier S 或 H。复核留下两处读法缺口，今天都没被利用：一是 `.github/actions/**` 不受管，却被算作「已在用的 action」清单；二是有几种门禁写法读法认不出。这张卡补上这两处，或明确写成已知限度。

## What

1. **N3.** `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` L2074 (main a2d0f737a8) counts `uses:` under `.github/actions` as already in use. `.github/actions/**` is not a register row. So an ungoverned composite-action edit can bring in a third-party action, and a later workflow edit can then adopt it at Tier S.
2. **N5.** `WORKFLOW_INVOCATIONS` (L1637) has no pattern for `git diff --exit-code`, `npx`, or `node`/`bash` on a path outside `scripts/`. A gate written that way is not tracked per job, so moving it out of its job reads S. No gate on main is written that way today.

## Ask

- N3: either make `.github/actions/**` a register row (that is a ruling: a decision card first, per #31424 rule 6) or drop it from the in-use inventory. Recommend the second, since it needs no ruling and only adds H.
- N5: widen `WORKFLOW_INVOCATIONS` to those spellings, or name them in the header as a known limit next to the run-text limit. Pin whichever it is.

Related: #31538, PR #31628.
